claims.claim: Every hard-gate-valid generated candidate can be retained as a dormant library object even when it has no current implementation use.
claims.passCondition: All nine starter candidates produce byte-reproducible stash projections with VALID_DORMANT_LIBRARY, KEEP_WHEN_NO_CURRENT_USE, ARCHIVED_NOT_ADMITTED_TO_RUNTIME, DORMANT, and no authority.
claims.counterevidence: A valid candidate is dropped, gains active authority, or rebuilds to different projection bytes.
claims.observedEvidence: 128 focused checks passed; nine projections passed exact rebuild, archive deduplication, fresh-process reload, and portable round-trip checks.

claims.claim: Selecting an organ changes only a digest-bound review overlay and does not mutate the archived candidate or activate it.
claims.passCondition: The immutable object bytes remain identical, a forged selection receipt is refused, and only the selected derived view changes after a valid receipt.
claims.secondarySurface: live IndexedDB selection and reload journey
claims.counterevidence: Candidate bytes change, an unbound receipt selects, or installed/registered/staged/promoted/CANON fields become true.
claims.observedEvidence: Filesystem byte comparison passed; forged receipt was refused; live browser retained three dormant organs while one gained SELECTED FOR REVIEW after reload.

claims.passCondition: The sender binds exact source bytes and an organs/*-organ.js path; an explicit receiver scan creates the exact predicted archive object while remaining dormant and non-admitted.
claims.primarySurface: Fabric envelope construction and digest assertions
claims.secondarySurface: real modules/ai-organ-archive scanAndArchive call in a temporary root
claims.counterevidence: Path refusal, source digest drift, different receiver object identity, organ execution, or runtime admission.

claims.namedSeam: The first temporary harness declared the repository root instead of the required organs source root; it failed visibly and the corrected contract-shaped harness passed.

claims.claim: Desktop and mobile Archive views visibly distinguish dormant, unselected, and selected-for-review states.
claims.passCondition: Three cards render without clipping at default desktop and 390x844, one selection changes only its label, the no-AI/false-authority boundary remains visible, and no browser errors occur.

claims.counterevidence: A metric, shelf, or archive admission claims usefulness, taste, fun, wisdom, compatibility, or CANON.
